review.reviewBody: If I don't have a can of beer, what can I use in it's place? Thank you!

This is a nice recipe for beef and mushroom pot roast, but why use a standing rib roast, which is much better roasted with dry heat. An arm roast or chuck roast works well here and is a LOT less expensive

I been cooking this recipe for decades! Super easy and tasty. Add sliced onions to the bottom of the slow cooker along with the mushrooms for another tasty addition. Strain the liquid from the vegis to a sauce pan, add some beef stock and thicken with a roux to make a nice gravy to accompany the dish. However; DO NOT use a standing rib roast for this recipe unless you are rich and WANT to waste your money and ruin a beautiful piece of meat! This recipe (or any recipe using a low and slow, moist heat cooking method) should always and ONLY use a cheaper cut like a chuck roast or similar tough cut of beef. A rib roast is already a tender cut and does not need or respond well to the long cooking times used in slow cooker recipes needed to break down connective tissue and render out fat. If you want to cook a rib roast use a DRY heat method. Otherwise enjoy!

Great! My husband raved about how tender the meat was. I actually adjusted it a little bit...I used 2 1oz packages of onion soup mix and I used a little over a 3lb chuck roast...the butcher said that would result in a very tender roast.
Lisa made this with a sirloin tip. Instead of beer, used two cans cream of mushroom soup. Added carrots as well. Put on low and was done in 5 hours.

Different cuts of meat need different cooking methods. This is not a roast beef, it is a pot roast. Use a chuck for this. I would never do this to a beautiful standing rib roast. It should be roasted in the oven just until the center reaches 130 degrees. Pink. tender and juicy like prime rib is supposed to be. (And the leftovers make delicious french dip sandwiches)

This was really good! I used a rump roast and Guiness Stout beer. During the last hour of cooking, I removed the roast, and whisked in a packet of mushroom gravy mix with the juices, then returned the roast for the remainder if the cook time. Yummy gravy for over rice or potatoes! Will definitely make again. Thank you for the easy recipe!

Very good, but I replaced onion soup mix with fresh onions, carrots, bay leaf and a bouquet garni of fresh thyme, parsley and rosemary tied with string, as well as a good stock cube dissolved into a few tablespoons of boiling water. Far better and fresher plus the veg adds to the unctuous gravy/sauce
Excellent! Added onions to the mushrooms & beef bouillon. Add gravy brown sauce & Velotine at end of cooking for awesome gravy.

Bad results due to beer! Had only 8 oz. mushrooms, added 2 medium carrots, and half sweet onion on bottom of pan. Placed 2.75 lb top sirloin tip roast on top, poured 12 oz. Cameron's Ambear Red Ale - made in Ontario. Spread 1 pkg. Knorr onion soup mix on top. This is my first time ever using a slow cooker - bought it 2 days ago just for this recipe. Beef was well done after 9 hours on low, vegetables were perfect, not mushy. Cooking juices smelled like pure BEER and yeast when I lifted the lid! Could not stand that smell! Never cooked with beer before. Lots of juice in the pot. Looking forward to it anyway............. 
Enjoyed the beef and vegetables, but could not stand the beer smell and taste. 
Otherwise very good with mashed potatoes. Removed the juices. Instead used beef stock and thickened it with gravy thickener. It was a little better that way. Love the crock pot, but will make beef roast again and again until I get the right combination of flavors. Will definitely sear the meat next time - it should add a lot of flavor. Disappointed but not giving up.
We used chuck roast instead but otherwise made it to spec. Then we toasted French rolls and used the liquid for an au jus. This recipe made a perfect French dip sandwich!!!
I looked at the $60 price for a standing rib roast - a cut that is already tender - and used a chuck roast. The results were delicious.
Added a bag of baby carrots for a side dish to the pot, great.
My family did not care for the beer taste.
What a dreadful waste of an expensive cut of previous prime beef. Please thing about your values in life of you waste money in this manner.
Excellent! Used ½ packet of dry onion soup mix to cut sodium in half.

I did make this recipe and it was so easy! I didn't use the standing rib roast it called for though: I used a different. I also added sliced onions and garlic. 

If you know absolutely nothing about beer, use Sam Adams. It gives an awesome flavor to the beef. 

I will make this again!!!!

Interesting recipe, I ate it all up!
Good.
Delicious! I'm so glad I found an easy recipe that is delicious!
this recipe is easy, but is huge in flavor i love this recipe so much i made it twice in one week. its is the best, love it and so does my family. the best
